text:
maria: quick API contract Q — can we add an optional top-level `routing_hint` that accepts {region, tier, model_id}? i'm worried about breaking strict clients if we add new top-level response fields or change fallback behavior.
jamie: we can add it as optional on request. default behavior must remain unchanged for existing clients. main question is fallthrough ordering and whether we expose route metadata in responses.
kevin: proposal for fallthrough: 1) requested region+tier exact, 2) requested region+compatible tier, 3) global region same tier, 4) fallback model variant. that keeps locality first.
leo: +1 for region-first. also: include `served_model` and `route_reason` in responses for observability. but many clients do strict schema checks so we should not inject those by default. suggest opt-in via header or query param.
maria: agree on opt-in. example header: `X-Redwood-Routing-Info: true`. only when present do we add `served_model` and `route_reason` to response body. we still log route metadata server-side.
jamie: streaming/func-calls note: for streaming responses we can emit a control event with routing info at the start or end of the stream. ensure SDKs surface it only when opt-in header is used.
kevin: i'll draft the API spec and a tiny PR with examples + compatibility section. will include a request/response example:
```json
// request
{
  "prompt": "...",
  "routing_hint": {"region": "us-west-2", "tier": "standard", "model_id": "redwood-2-large"}
}
// response (opt-in header present)
{
  "id": "...",
  "text": "...",
  "served_model": "redwood-2-large-q8",
  "route_reason": "region-tier-exact"
}
```
leo: add unit tests that verify legacy clients (no header) do not see extra fields. also add an API linter rule blocking unintended top-level additions.
maria: plan: kevin opens PR (#2345), jamie to add SDK flag to set header, leo to add tests & linter. i'll review today. ship opt-in in api-proxy v1.8.0 canary, monitor. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: api-proxy v1.8.0 -> canary 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z
maria: thanks — if anyone sees other edge cases (cross-region fallbacks for reserved capacity, dedicated vs hosted model variants), drop them on the PR thread.
